title: What The Sitar Knows — EN/HI/ES (Chas McIvor)
style: jazz lounge piano bar dry wit spoken word observational 102bpm upright bass brushed snare deadpan baritone male vocal Hindi Spanish Indian philosophy language learning
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
The sitar starts before the light arrives
Five in the morning and already something comes alive
Seven strings in sympathy, the drone beneath the air
The sitar knows the distance between silence and a prayer

[Verse 2 — Hindi, with English translation]
सितार जानता है जो हम नहीं जानते
[The sitar knows what we do not know]
रागों में छिपे हैं जीवन के सपने
[In the ragas are hidden the dreams of life]
सुबह का राग अलग है शाम के राग से
[The morning raga is different from the evening raga]
सितार हर पल को संगीत में बदल देता है
[The sitar transforms every moment into music]

[Chorus — English]
What does the sitar know that I don't know?
The answer's in the raga and the way the feelings go
What does the sitar know at five AM?
It knows the space between the notes is where you find your zen
That's my boy

[Bridge — Spanish, with English translation]
El sitar sabe lo que el corazón no puede decir
[The sitar knows what the heart cannot say]
Las cuerdas hablan en un lenguaje sin mentir
[The strings speak in a language without lying]
Siete cuerdas pero mil emociones adentro
[Seven strings but a thousand emotions within]
El sitar es maestro, nosotros somos el sustento
[The sitar is the master, we are the foundation]

[Outro — All three languages]
What the sitar knows… सितार क्या जानता है… Lo que sabe el sitar
Twenty years to learn — बीस साल सीखने के लिए — Veinte años para aprender
That's my boy
